referenceAuthoring.subject: Mature coastal farm oak with a grounded bifurcated trunk and layered faceted crown

sources.notes: Defines Neva's warm tactile faceting, palette discipline, and gameplay-camera readability.
A local candidate study used only for hierarchy, branch windows, and crown-mass comparison.
Borrow the feature-inventory and multi-view iteration method, not its direct Three.js shipping path.

components.role: Carries the main gesture and species identity from ground to crown
components.shape: Two to three connected low-sided tapered sections with a visible upper fork
cues: Broader below the first fork
Gentle seeded lean without an S-curve

components.role: Grounds the tree and breaks the pole-like base silhouette
components.shape: Short tapered wedges radiating irregularly into the soil plane
cues: Readable at 8 m
Uneven lengths with no starburst symmetry

components.role: Connects the trunk gesture to distinct crown masses
components.shape: Tapered angular limbs with one controlled secondary split each
cues: At least two branches remain visible from the front
Branches terminate inside foliage masses

components.role: Defines the broad crown silhouette and asymmetric weight distribution
components.shape: Four overlapping faceted lobes with different widths and elevations
cues: Crown is wider than it is tall
One side carries visibly more weight

components.role: Breaks the major lobes into readable planar clusters without noise
components.shape: Smaller compressed faceted clusters nested around major lobe edges
cues: Cluster sizes vary in a bounded range
Lower and rear clusters use the shadow foliage token

silhouette: The lower trunk reads as one grounded mass before separating into an obvious upper fork.
Four unequal crown lobes create a broad asymmetrical umbrella rather than a round ball.
The crown edge alternates large planar steps with two or three deliberate branch-led protrusions.
Root flares widen the base without competing with the trunk as the primary vertical gesture.
negativeSpace: Preserve one daylight window between the two dominant upper trunk branches from the front view.
Keep two smaller gaps between major crown lobes visible from front and three-quarter views.
Leave the lower crown high enough that the trunk and primary branches remain readable at 15 m.

requirements: Rear branches must continue the same load-bearing hierarchy instead of mirroring the front exactly.
Rear canopy masses must close the volume while preserving side-view gaps and a non-spherical outline.

criticalFeatures.requirement: The base reads as planted and weight-bearing from gameplay distance, never as a cone placed on the ground.
At least two tapered primary branches and the upper fork remain visible in front and three-quarter views.
Major lobes own the silhouette while minor clusters add facet rhythm without turning into uniform pebble noise.
Deliberate gaps expose branch structure and prevent the crown from becoming a single opaque blob.

parameterBindings.purpose: Controls the full vertical hierarchy and the elevation of the readable crown.
Controls the crown width, branch reach, and spacing between major lobes.
Allocates four primary lobes first and uses the remainder for bounded secondary breakup.
Applies one coherent seeded gesture to trunk joints and crown center.
Controls the number of load-bearing limbs without changing the required visible fork.
Controls irregular grounding wedges while preserving a non-symmetric base.

failureModes: A single straight cone or cylinder carries the entire trunk without a visible connected fork.
Canopy clusters merge into a spherical lollipop or an evenly spaced golden-angle shell.
Branches float outside the trunk, end before foliage, or disappear completely behind the crown.
Random detail is added without improving silhouette, hierarchy, grounding, or negative space.
A flattering front render passes while rear, side, or gameplay-distance views collapse.

referenceAuthoring.subject: Seeded faceted meadow grass clump with a grounded base and a readable wind-swept gesture

sources.notes: Defines Neva's warm tactile faceting, palette discipline, authored asymmetry, and gameplay-distance readability.

components.role: Anchors the clump to terrain without a floating central knot
components.shape: Low radial gathering of overlapping blade bases
cues: Base stays broad and visually grounded
No circular pedestal silhouette

components.role: Creates the main height rhythm and directional grass gesture
components.shape: Tapered low-poly blades with varied lean and bounded height
cues: Three height tiers remain readable
Lean favors one direction without uniformity

components.role: Breaks the outer silhouette with sparse contrasting facets
components.shape: Shorter and taller edge blades placed asymmetrically
cues: Outer tips do not form a circle
Palette variation follows blade groups

silhouette: The clump reads as a low asymmetric fan rather than a radial starburst.
Three unequal height peaks create a clear rhythm at gameplay distance.
Outer blades taper into sparse tips with no hard rectangular edge.
negativeSpace: Preserve narrow gaps between the three dominant blade groups.
Keep the center porous enough for individual blade planes to read in close view.

requirements: Rear blades continue the directional lean while varying height and spacing.
Side views retain a grounded base and do not collapse into one flat plane.

criticalFeatures.requirement: Blade roots overlap the ground plane as one planted clump with no floating tips.
At least three unequal height groups remain legible from the gameplay camera.
Seeded variation produces a coherent lean and irregular outline without noisy rotation.

parameterBindings.purpose: Controls density while preserving the required gaps and height hierarchy.
Controls the dominant vertical read and separation between blade tiers.
Controls ground footprint and the amount of readable negative space.

failureModes: Blades form an even radial starburst or a circular brush silhouette.
The base floats above terrain or collapses into a visible central pedestal.
Random blade angles create noisy micro-detail without a coherent wind gesture.

referenceAuthoring.subject: Small coastal wildflower clump with layered stems, sparse blossoms, and meadow-scale readability

sources.notes: Defines Neva's restrained accent colors, broad facets, authored asymmetry, and gameplay-camera readability.

components.role: Provides a grounded branching scaffold for the flower heads
components.shape: Several slender faceted stems rising in unequal arcs
cues: Stems begin as one loose ground cluster
Heights vary in a clear stepped rhythm

components.role: Carries the restrained color accent visible over meadow grass
components.shape: Simple low-sided petal fans around compact centers
cues: Blossoms face varied directions
Accent color remains a small area

components.role: Connects stems to the terrain and broadens the base silhouette
components.shape: Short tapered leaf planes angled close to the ground
cues: Leaves overlap soil at their roots
No symmetric rosette

silhouette: Unequal blossom heights make a loose triangular rhythm rather than a bouquet dome.
One or two flower heads lead while the remaining heads support the silhouette.
Low ground leaves widen the base without creating a circular rosette.
negativeSpace: Keep daylight gaps between dominant stems visible from front and side views.
Separate adjacent blossom heads so their petal fans do not merge into one color blob.

requirements: Rear stems fill the volume with different heights and headings rather than duplicating the front.
Every side view retains at least two separated blossom heads and a grounded leaf base.

criticalFeatures.requirement: Flower heads stay individually readable and do not merge into a single saturated cluster.
Accent petals remain subordinate to grass and foliage colors at gameplay distance.
All stems visually emerge from a low planted base with no floating geometry.

parameterBindings.purpose: Controls blossom density while preserving separation and an unequal height hierarchy.
Controls the dominant vertical read relative to surrounding grass cover.
Controls the ground footprint and negative space between stems.

failureModes: Blossoms merge into a bright spherical bouquet that dominates the terrain.
Stems are evenly spaced or equal height, creating a procedural picket-fence rhythm.
The plant floats, lacks a leaf base, or collapses into one flat billboard from the side.

referenceAuthoring.subject: Ground-hugging faceted pebble cluster with varied stone sizes and an eroded coastal scatter rhythm

sources.notes: Defines authored planar stone geometry, grounded contact, palette discipline, and controlled detail density.

components.role: Establishes the cluster scale and dominant directional gesture
components.shape: Low irregular faceted stone with a compressed crown
cues: Largest stone sits off center
Broad face remains readable from above

components.role: Builds a loose eroded grouping around the dominant stone
components.shape: Varied flattened polyhedra with different axes and tilts
cues: At least three distinct sizes
No repeated orientation sequence

components.role: Tapers the scatter into the surrounding soil or shore
components.shape: Small low wedges placed along two uneven outer arcs
cues: Edges fade asymmetrically
Chips never form a ring

silhouette: The cluster forms an irregular low wedge rather than a circular pile.
One dominant stone and two supporting peaks control the top-down read.
Small edge chips taper the group into terrain along unequal sides.
negativeSpace: Preserve visible ground gaps between the largest three stones.
Leave one open side so the cluster reads as deposited rather than deliberately arranged.

requirements: Undersides stay close to the ground plane and do not expose floating gaps on slopes.
Rear stones vary their axes while supporting the same off-center dominant mass.

criticalFeatures.requirement: The cluster has one obvious largest stone plus at least two smaller scale tiers.
Every stone sits low enough to read as embedded in the terrain surface.
Spacing and axes create a natural deposited rhythm without rings or grids.

parameterBindings.purpose: Allocates one dominant stone first and distributes the remainder across support tiers.
Controls cluster footprint and the amount of visible ground between stones.
Controls the base stone scale while seeded ratios preserve the hierarchy.

failureModes: Pebbles form a regular ring, grid, or evenly spaced radial pattern.
All stones share one size and orientation, producing a stamped procedural look.
Stones float above terrain or expose deep undersides from the gameplay camera.

referenceAuthoring.subject: Sturdy low-poly slatted timber worm compost bin with propped-open angled lid and rich bedding

sources.notes: Defines warm timber faceting, metal strap accents, and grounded farm aesthetic.
Hero isometric concept study defining slat spacing, propped lid angle, and soil volume.
Multi-angle structural decomposition and critical-feature verification method.

components.role: Grounded vertical structural columns providing frame strength
components.shape: Four upright low-poly timber posts with chamfered caps
cues: Chamfered pyramidal top caps
Extends slightly past the topmost slat

components.role: Horizontal wall enclosure allowing aeration for worm culture
components.shape: Evenly spaced wooden planks around four sides with narrow ventilation gaps
cues: Narrow horizontal daylight gaps between boards
Planar faceted timber bevels

components.role: Protective weather cover tilted open to reveal working compost layer
components.shape: Angled plank panel braced by transverse wooden battens
cues: Tilted upwards by lidAngleDeg
Overhangs side frame by 5-10 cm

components.role: Diagonal timber support prop holding the lid open
components.shape: Slender angled wooden rod notched into the upper side frame
cues: Visible under open lid on right side
Locks lid at comfortable inspection angle

components.role: Active vermicompost substrate containing rich soil and worms
components.shape: Faceted undulating dark soil bed inside the lower interior volume
cues: Warm rich earth tone contrasting with timber
Low-poly faceted surface facets

components.role: Heavy dark iron strap hinges and corner brackets
components.shape: Flat rectangular metal plates with low-poly rivet fasteners
cues: Dark metal contrast against warm wood
Fastener accents on corner joins

silhouette: Boxy timber bin silhouette broken by an expressive angled lid resting on a diagonal prop arm.
Prominent corner posts extend past the horizontal slat line to create a stable, grounded silhouette.
Clear horizontal daylight gaps between side slats prevent the bin from reading as a solid block.
negativeSpace: Large wedge of daylight between the tilted lid and upper bin rim reveals the interior soil bed.
Horizontal ventilation gaps between consecutive wooden slats let background light through.

requirements: Rear slats and rear corner posts follow the identical horizontal spacing rhythm as front slats.
Underside of the lid features matching transverse battens and dark metal strap hinge mounts.

criticalFeatures.requirement: The lid remains visibly propped open at an angle to display the active compost interior.
Timber planks feature distinct physical gaps rather than a flat textured box texture.
Rich dark faceted vermicompost soil is clearly visible and readable from standard gameplay view.
Dark metal strap hinges and corner brackets provide structural credibility and material richness.

parameterBindings.purpose: Controls the number of horizontal wooden slat tiers and vertical ventilation spacing.
Controls the tilt angle of the open cover and the length of the support prop arm.
Controls the depth and elevation of the interior faceted compost substrate layer.

failureModes: A solid closed rectangular box without an open lid or visible interior compost bedding.
Thin paper-like slats without physical thickness or visible daylight aeration gaps.
Lid floating in mid-air above the bin without a visible hinge attachment or support prop.

referenceAuthoring.subject: Handcrafted coastal fishing rod with contoured timber grip, classic brass fly reel, graduated line guides, and dynamic casting arc

sources.notes: Defines warm tactile low-poly faceting, functional coastal styling, and gameplay readability.

components.role: Contoured warm cork/wood grip providing comfortable hand contact and ergonomic silhouette
components.shape: Tapered faceted cylinder with chamfered butt cap and foregrip
cues: Readable wood grain token
Winding bands frame the reel seat

components.role: Machined centerpin reel with crank handle and coiled line drum
components.shape: Ported brass cage frame with central spool, side crank arm, and turning knob
cues: Brass metalness
Visible wound line coil

components.role: Multi-stage flexible rod shaft carrying the casting arc gesture
components.shape: Faceted tapered sections linked by metallic ferrule rings
cues: Loaded forward curve
Progressive diameter reduction

components.role: Graduated ring eyes directing the line along the blank
components.shape: Low-poly circular eye rings with mounting feet and thread whippings
cues: Stripper guide is largest near reel
Tip-top loop caps the rod end

components.role: Tensioned fishing line and signature coastal teardrop float
components.shape: Faceted segmented line running through guides and dropping to a two-tone red and cream bobber
cues: Terracotta top and foam white bottom on bobber
Central wooden spindle pin

silhouette: Graceful forward flexed arc prevents the rod from looking like a stiff rigid pole.
Distinct reel offset and handle contour create an instantly identifiable fishing tool outline.
Graduated guide rings and hanging bobber add delicate character-scale detail without micro-noise.
negativeSpace: Clear daylight window between the reel frame and the blank.
Spaced openings through each line guide eye along the shaft arc.
Visible clearance between the hanging bobber line and the rod blank.

requirements: Reel mount and foot securely lock into the reel seat hoods without disconnected floating parts.
Guides are symmetrically aligned along the forward casting spine of the blank.

criticalFeatures.requirement: The blank displays a smooth, seeded progressive flex rather than a straight segmented cylinder.
The reel possesses a clearly distinct frame, line spool, and side crank handle knob.
The rigged line features a classic two-tone terracotta/cream bobber float with central spindle.

parameterBindings.purpose: Controls overall rod height and section proportions.
Controls the spacing and graduated scaling of guide eyes.
Controls the graceful loaded curvature of the blank.
Controls reel proportions relative to the handle.

failureModes: The rod appears as a rigid, unbent pole with no flex or personality.
The reel is a plain cylinder without bracket, crank arm, or spool separation.
Guide rings are identical in size rather than graduated from stripper to tip.
Floating parts or disconnected line paths.

referenceAuthoring.subject: Weathered coastal driftwood cluster with crossed branches, bleached facets, and a low tide-line silhouette

sources.notes: Defines warm tactile faceting, coastal material restraint, grounded contact, and gameplay-camera readability.

components.role: Establishes the cluster length and tide-driven directional gesture
components.shape: Tapered low-sided branch with a gentle angular bend
cues: Longest piece leads the silhouette
One end is thicker and more grounded

components.role: Creates depth and a readable caught-together structure
components.shape: Shorter tapered branches crossing at unequal angles
cues: Crossings visibly contact the main log
Angles avoid a regular fan

components.role: Communicates weathering and breaks the cylindrical silhouette
components.shape: Uneven faceted end cuts and short branch stubs
cues: Ends vary in width and angle
Bleached token stays on limited faces

silhouette: One long diagonal leads the cluster while shorter pieces create an unequal crossing rhythm.
The pile remains low and elongated rather than forming a campfire-like radial star.
Broken ends and branch stubs create two or three deliberate outline interruptions.
negativeSpace: Keep triangular ground gaps visible between crossing logs.
Leave one end of the main log unobstructed so its taper remains readable.

requirements: Lower log faces stay close to the terrain while preserving visible contact at crossings.
Rear and side views confirm the logs intersect plausibly instead of floating through one another.

criticalFeatures.requirement: The longest weathered log controls the cluster direction and has a clearly tapered profile.
Shorter pieces visibly rest against the main log with no floating or deep interpenetration.
Faceted broken ends and restrained bleaching communicate shore weathering without texture noise.

parameterBindings.purpose: Controls the number of pieces while preserving one dominant log and credible crossings.
Controls the elongated tide-line silhouette and support-log proportions.
Controls the leading gesture while seeded offsets prevent a regular radial fan.

failureModes: Logs form a symmetric campfire star or evenly spaced fan.
Pieces float, pass deeply through each other, or lack readable points of contact.
Uniform cylinders and noisy bleaching erase the faceted weathered-wood hierarchy.

Broken ends and branch stubs create two or three deliberate outline interruptions.
negativeSpace: Keep triangular ground gaps visible between crossing logs.
Leave one end of the main log unobstructed so its taper remains readable.

requirements: Lower log faces stay close to the terrain while preserving visible contact at crossings.
Rear and side views confirm the logs intersect plausibly instead of floating through one another.

criticalFeatures.requirement: The longest weathered log controls the cluster direction and has a clearly tapered profile.
Shorter pieces visibly rest against the main log with no floating or deep interpenetration.
Faceted broken ends and restrained bleaching communicate shore weathering without texture noise.

parameterBindings.purpose: Controls the number of pieces while preserving one dominant log and credible crossings.
Controls the elongated tide-line silhouette and support-log proportions.
Controls the leading gesture while seeded offsets prevent a regular radial fan.

failureModes: Logs form a symmetric campfire star or evenly spaced fan.
Pieces float, pass deeply through each other, or lack readable points of contact.
Uniform cylinders and noisy bleaching erase the faceted weathered-wood hierarchy.
